# Custom Webhooks triggers

## Custom Webhook

Runs when another app or website visits a web link you made in Cuebot (a custom hook). Use it to start actions from your own tools.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Hook name** | Only run for the hook with this name. Leave empty to run for every hook you made. |
| **Include test events** | Tick to also run for test events (made with a "send test" button). Untick to run only for real ones. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%hookName%` | The hook's name |
| `%method%` | How it was called, like GET or POST |
| `%query%` | The extra bits added after the ? in the link |
| `%body%` | The text that was sent along |
| `%contentType%` | What kind of data was sent |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |
| `%query.NAME%` | Each item in the link's ? part, by its name |

<small>Type id: `webhook.custom`</small>
